title: Autonomic request safeguard orchestrator for regional and tier routing
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Build an autonomous orchestration layer that detects overload signals (429 rate-limits, upstream timeouts, elevated error-rate windows) at per-region and per-tier granularity and materializes automatic, reversible mitigation actions: variant fallback, soft-degrade routing, adaptive rate-limits, and circuit breaker state transitions. The goal is to protect tail latency and SLA targets for paying customers while minimizing customer-facing degradation and avoiding cascade failures. This ticket scopes the first implementation: policy engine, signal aggregation, hysteresis/decay model, rollout plan, and observability surfaces. Implementation must support configurable thresholds per region/tier/model-variant, a conservative canary rollout, and tie into Redis-backed sentinel state for cross-process enforcement.
acceptance_criteria: Policy engine accepts JSON policy manifests with per-region, per-tier thresholds for 429, p95 latency, and error-rate over configurable windows
Signal aggregator ingests router telemetry (429 counts, 5xx counts, latency histograms) and computes rolling trip scores used by the policy engine

Three mitigation actions are implemented and reversible: route to fallback variant, apply soft-degrade flags (lower token budget/shorten max length), and engage per-tenant circuit breaker with decaying probation
Circuit breaker state is persisted and visible in Console; actions are auditable with links to triggering telemetry and decision rationale
Canary rollout to us-west-2 and a low-traffic tier (tier=dev) with automatic rollback on false-positive safeguards within 48 hours
End-to-end tests and chaos scenarios added: simulated surge of 429s, synthetic downstream timeout, and elevated 5xx to validate no cascade and graceful recovery
Design doc and implementation PRs are reviewed by runtime, routing, and console owners and have follow-up TODOs tracked
comments: 2025-02-13 - Liam O'Connor: Initial spike session completed. Proposed using a decaying trip-score (exponential backoff with floor) to avoid flapping between states. Will prototype score computation in routing-sim repo.

2025-02-20 - Priya Shah (PM): Need explicit UX language for 'soft-degrade' to ensure customers understand the reduction in throughput may not equal loss in semantic quality. Add examples for embeddings vs. chat flows.

2025-03-01 - Design review (Maya Li): Approved policy manifest shape; asked for additional labels for 'customer-impact' and 'rollback-reason' in audit trail.
2025-03-04 - Ava Martinez: Prototype completed for scoring and hysteresis model. Observed one false-positive on bursty test; tuned sensitivity and added per-tenant probation periods. Preparing PR.

notes: Decision: Start with conservative default thresholds: 429_rate > 1% over 1m OR p95 latency > 1200ms over 1m OR error_rate > 0.5% over 5m will increment trip-score. Thresholds adjustable by tenant/region/tier.
Trade-offs: aggressive fallbacks reduce cost and protect latency but risk degrading semantic quality. We'll expose policy knobs in Console for enterprise tenants (read-only for self-serve).
Telemetry: add decision_reason tag on request traces and emit 'safeguard.action' events with fields: region, tier, tenant_id, trigger_signals, action, trip_score_before, trip_score_after.
